result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is unexpectedly clipped mid-character.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped mid-character on the right, rendering as 'Tokumaru Rameı' despite ample horizontal space between the title and the '4.8 (500+)' rating.
issues.suggestion: Expand the title text container's available width (e.g., using flex-grow or removing an unintended fixed width) and apply proper text wrapping or ellipsis truncation if needed so characters are not cut off mid-glyph.
